ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.08:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform low-intensity black pigmentation. High-contrast white contiguous pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips and as discrete circular rosettes on the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped angle of approximately 75 degrees; vertex depth is moderate, though the absolute base is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serrations with approximately 8 distinct peaks. Right lobe exhibits lower-frequency, more rounded undulating topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct upward concave trajectory, sweeping toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white pixel clusters localized at both distal tips. Three distinct circular 'ring' scars are visible on the interior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization appearing as high-intensity white, jagged protrusions on the outer distal margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The left lobe presents a significantly more irregular and jagged trailing edge silhouette compared to the relatively smoother right lobe.
